Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Remote Google Ads Specialist position. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and data-driven decision-making, I am confident in my ability to deliver measurable results for your clients.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I regularly use Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance and guide strategy. My hands-on experience with SEMrush and Ahrefs has sharpened my ability to analyze data and optimize campaigns.

On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This has given me a unique perspective on aligning technical execution with strategic goals.

I am a quick learner, highly organized, and thrive in remote work environments. I am eager to bring my analytical mindset and results-oriented approach to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your success.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Remote Google Ads Specialist position. Your emphasis on strategic thinking, data-driven execution, and continuous improvement resonates with my professional approach and technical background.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, but I also actively use Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance and inform decisions. This hands-on experience has taught me to set clear goals, measure success, and refine strategies based on data—skills directly applicable to managing Google Ads campaigns.

One of my proudest achievements is my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a WordPress site for a youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. Through iterative audits, I measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project demonstrates my ability to think strategically, execute technically, and continuously optimize for better results.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it requires a balance of analytical rigor and creative problem-solving. My experience with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads, combined with my technical background in web development, allows me to understand both the 'why' and the 'how' behind campaign performance. I am also committed to continuous learning, as evidenced by my ongoing Dutch classes and my exploration of emerging trends like GEO and AEO.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am fully equipped for remote work. I am eager to bring my unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and results focus to your team. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your clients' growth.

Sincerely,
